# plotwork_import (Data Source)

Turns files of another format into Plotwork diagram source: Terraform, Terraform plan or state JSON, Bicep, ARM, CloudFormation, Pulumi, Kubernetes manifests, Helm, Docker Compose, SQL, OpenAPI and more. Pass `source` to `plotwork_render` for an SVG or to `plotwork_diagram` to publish it.

The files are sent to the Plotwork API, worked on in memory, and not stored. Send configuration, not state: state can hold secrets. Needs the Pro plan or above.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Draw the Terraform files of this module.
data "plotwork_import" "network" {
  format = "terraform"
  title  = "Production network"
  files = {
    for f in fileset(path.module, "*.tf") : f => file("${path.module}/${f}")
  }
}

# Draw a Kubernetes manifest.
data "plotwork_import" "cluster" {
  format = "kubernetes"
  text   = file("${path.module}/k8s/app.yaml")
}

output "network_coverage" {
  value = data.plotwork_import.network.coverage
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `format` (String) What the files are, such as `terraform`, `terraform-plan`, `kubernetes`, `compose`, `bicep` or `sql`. The [importing from code and data](https://docs.plotwork.dev/importing-from-code-and-data) guide lists every value.

### Optional

- `files` (Map of String) The files of a folder, by path, for a format that spans files such as a Terraform module: `{ for f in fileset(path.module, "*.tf") : f => file("${path.module}/${f}") }`.
- `group_by` (String) How resources are framed, such as `module` (the default for Terraform).
- `icons` (String) `auto` (the default) puts a provider's icon on each resource; `off` draws none.
- `root` (String) The root module, stack or template to draw when the files hold several.
- `text` (String) The content of one file. Set `text` or `files`, not both.
- `title` (String) The diagram's title. Taken from the files when left out.
- `var_files` (List of String) Paths of variables files among `files` to apply, such as `prod.tfvars`.
- `view` (String) For a format drawn several ways, which picture to draw.

### Read-Only

- `complete` (Boolean) True when nothing in the files was left out of the diagram.
- `coverage` (String) How much of the files the diagram shows, in one sentence.
- `id` (String) The SHA-256 of `source`.
- `kind` (String) The kind of diagram the files became, such as `flow` or `schema`.
- `outline` (List of String) The diagram as plain text, to check it says what the files say.
- `parts_total` (Number) When the files are too big for one readable diagram, how many diagrams they were split into; `source` is the first. 0 when the import is one diagram.
- `source` (String) The Plotwork source of the diagram.
- `summary` (String) A one-line description of the diagram, usable as alt text.
- `warnings` (List of String) What was left out or changed, one line each with its code, place and hint.
